name: Sree Chithra Art Gallery
summary: Sree Chithra Art Gallery is a state art gallery near the zoo gate in Thiruvananthapuram, opened to the public in 1935. Most of its paintings are by Raja Ravi Varma, alongside the Bengal school, the Roerichs, Mughal and Rajasthani miniatures and Tibetan thangkas.
highlights: Opened to the public on 25 September 1935
Largest part of the collection by Raja Ravi Varma
Bengal school, Nicholas and Svetoslav Roerich, Mughal and Rajasthani miniatures
Run by the Department of Museums and Zoos, Government of Kerala
